subject: β-Arrestin2: A Sex-Specific Molecular Switch in Alzheimer's Pathology
script: From Agewell Brief: β-Arrestin2: A Sex-Specific Molecular Switch in Alzheimer's Pathology. New preclinical research reveals that deleting β-arrestin2 in male mice reduces amyloid pathology and rescues cognition, while females remain largely unaffected—underscoring the need for sex-stratified approaches to GPCR-targeted therapies. Alzheimer's disease is not sex-neutral. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
